item.title: Brush fires cause road closures in Volusia County
item.description: A series of brush fires shut down portions of Interstate 95 in Volusia County between the roadways connections with Interstate 4 and Dunlawton Avenue in Daytona Beach Feb. 15, according to the Florida Department of Transportation. item.title: Vehicle break-in attempts reported in Victoria Hills
item.description: DeLand — Residents of the Victoria Hills neighborhood are being asked to remain alert after surveillance cameras captured multiple individuals attempting to enter vehicles during the early morning hours of Feb. 14. item.title: Trump presides over a lawless regime
item.description: Editor, The Beacon: “Obey the law and there won’t be a problem” was the headline in David Rauschenberger’s recent column in The Beacon. item.description: Roundabouts are no longer a novelty in Volusia County. They are becoming part of our daily commute. Anyone who drives through DeLand has seen it firsthand. item.description: Downtown DeLand went to the dogs Saturday as costumed pups, decorated floats and enthusiastic owners filled the streets for the annual DeLand Dog Parade.
